acceptanceCriteria.criterion: rustybt Momentum implementation exists at tests/validation/strategies/rustybt/momentum.py with RustyBTValidatedStrategy base, RSI indicator calculation, trailing stop logic, default params rsi_period=14, oversold=30, overbought=70, trailing_stop_pct=0.05, buy when RSI less than 30 (oversold), sell when RSI greater than 70 (overbought), exit via trailing stop at 5%

Backtrader Momentum implementation exists at tests/validation/strategies/backtrader/momentum.py with BacktraderValidatedStrategy base, bt.indicators.RSI or equivalent, equivalent trailing stop logic, logically equivalent to rustybt

Trailing stop logic correctly implemented: LONG positions stop_price = max(stop_price, current_price * (1 - trailing_pct)), SHORT positions stop_price = min(stop_price, current_price * (1 + trailing_pct)), stop price only ratchets in favorable direction, exit triggered when price crosses stop

Strategy audit checklist passed: same RSI calculation (note: may be DESIGN difference due to Wilder's smoothing), same trailing stop logic, same entry conditions (RSI thresholds), same exit conditions (RSI + trailing stop)
Log stop price updates for comparison: log RSI value on each bar, log stop price updates when position exists, log exit trigger reason (RSI exit vs trailing stop)
Unit tests verify: RSI calculation logic, trailing stop ratcheting behavior, entry/exit signal generation, position management with stops

artifact.reason: Base class for rustybt validated strategies - extend for Momentum strategy
Decorator for trailing stop and order logging
Base class for Backtrader validated strategies

constraints.constraint: Strategies must extend ValidatedStrategy base classes
Log stop price updates explicitly for comparison
Default parameters: rsi_period=14, oversold_threshold=30, overbought_threshold=70, trailing_stop_pct=0.05
RSI calculation may differ between frameworks (Wilder's smoothing vs simple average) - document as DESIGN finding if detected
Trailing stop only ratchets in favorable direction (never moves against position)
Exit trigger reason must be explicit in logs: "trailing_stop" or "rsi_exit"

methods.method: __init__(self, log_path: Path, rsi_period: int = 14, oversold: int = 30, overbought: int = 70, trailing_stop_pct: float = 0.05)
compute_rsi(self, prices: list[float], period: int) -> float

interface.name: trailing_stop_logic
interface.signature: LONG: stop_price = max(stop_price, price * (1 - pct)); SHORT: stop_price = min(stop_price, price * (1 + pct))
interface.description: Trailing stop ratcheting logic - stop only moves in favorable direction

interface.name: RSI formula
interface.description: Relative Strength Index calculation (may use Wilder's smoothing or simple average)

tests.standards: Use pytest with @pytest.mark.layer_2_signals and @pytest.mark.layer_3_orders markers. Follow Zero Mock Enforcement. Test trailing stop ratcheting behavior explicitly.

ideas.idea: Test RSI calculation correctly identifies oversold (RSI less than 30)

Test trailing stop does NOT ratchet down for LONG on falling prices
Test trailing stop triggers exit when price crosses stop
